message: Hi Alex, it's Chloe at Rapid Plumbing, interesting. What does this cost?
reply: Hi Chloe, thanks for the quick reply! It's a flat $900 one-time fix pack covering the issues we find in your audit (speed, mobile, broken links, that kind of thing) – no guarantees, just honest fixes. After that, an optional $250/month care plan keeps things maintained if you want it. No pressure either way. Want me to send the audit findings first?
